Diamond & Pearl series · SF

Stormfront

Released November 1, 2008 · 106 cards

Stormfront is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Diamond & Pearl series, released in English on November 1, 2008. Its main set has 100 cards, plus 6 secret rares numbered beyond the set (106 in total). It includes 92 Pokémon, 12 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

24 illustrators worked on Stormfront. Most cards: Ryo Ueda (11), Kent Kanetsuna (10), Mitsuhiro Arita (9), Kouki Saitou (8), Atsuko Nishida (6), Kagemaru Himeno (6), Hajime Kusajima (5), Midori Harada (5).
